license_required.quote: any person or firm or corporation who for a fixed price, commission, fee, or wage, undertakes to bid upon or to construct or who undertakes to superintend or manage... the construction of any building, highway, public utilities, grading or any improvement or structure where the cost of the undertaking is forty thousand dollars ($40,000) or more... shall be deemed to be a "general contractor" engaged in the business of general contracting in the State of North Carolina.

required.quote: Anyone seeking to be licensed as a general contractor in this State shall submit an application. Before being entitled to an examination, an applicant shall: (1) Be at least 18 years of age. (2) Possess good moral character as determined by the Board. (3) Provide evidence of financial responsibility as determined by the Board.

exams.name: General Contractor Qualifying Examination
exams.notes: Examination tests ability to make practical application of knowledge of contracting, reading plans and specifications, North Carolina State Building Code knowledge, estimating costs, construction, ethics, and related matters. A 'qualifier' or 'qualifying party' must pass the exam.
exams.jurisdiction: State (State Licensing Board for General Contractors)
exams.quote: An applicant shall identify an individual who has successfully passed an examination approved by the Board who, for purposes of this section, shall be known as the 'qualifier' or the 'qualifying party' of the applicant.

interval_years.quote: A license shall expire on the first day of January following its issuance or renewal and shall become invalid 60 days from that date unless renewed

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Renewal applications shall be submitted with a fee not to exceed one hundred twenty-five dollars ($125.00) for an unlimited license

required.quote: As a condition of license renewal, at least one qualifier or qualifying party of a licensee holding a building contractor, residential contractor, or unclassified contractor license classification shall complete, on an annual basis, eight hours of continuing education approved in accordance with this section.

hours_per_period.quote: shall complete, on an annual basis, eight hours of continuing education approved in accordance with this section.

period_years.quote: shall complete, on an annual basis, eight hours of continuing education

value: 2 hours mandatory course approved by the Board
6 hours elective courses approved by the Board
topical_requirements.quote: Of the eight hours of annual continuing education required by this section, two hours shall be a mandatory course approved by the Board and the remaining six hours shall be elective courses approved by the Board.

available.quote: To the extent that other states which provide for the licensing of general contractors provide for similar action, the Board in its discretion may grant licenses of the same or equivalent classification to general contractors licensed by other states, without written examination upon satisfactory proof furnished to the Board that the qualifications of such applicants are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in North Carolina and upon payment of the required fee.

requirements.value: Reciprocity available to the extent other states provide for similar action; applicant must show qualifications equal to NC licensees and pay required fee; no written examination required.

regulatory_model.quote: Any person, firm, or corporation not being duly authorized who shall contract for or bid upon the construction of any of the projects or works enumerated in G.S. 87-1, without having first complied with the provisions hereof, or who shall attempt to practice general contracting in the State, except as provided for in this Article... shall be deemed guilty of a Class 2 misdemeanor.

definition_quote.value: any person or firm or corporation who for a fixed price, commission, fee, or wage, undertakes to bid upon or to construct or who undertakes to superintend or manage, on his own behalf or for any person, firm, or corporation that is not licensed as a general contractor pursuant to this Article, the construction of any building, highway, public utilities, grading or any improvement or structure where the cost of the undertaking is forty thousand dollars ($40,000) or more, or undertakes to erect a North Carolina labeled manufactured modular building meeting the North Carolina State Building Code, shall be deemed to be a "general contractor" engaged in the business of general contracting in the State of North Carolina.
